messages:
olga (CS): drafting a 1-page 'priming & triage' note for churn-risk accounts. short checklist + 15min walkthrough. can someone sanity-check numbers?

ryan (ENG): yep. keep defaults conservative for field use: cache TTL 25s, max_batch 12, batch_timeout 10ms, streaming=true. include a safe rollback line.

maria (CS Ops): pre-warm plan: 1) prefill top-7 prompts at 8 qps for 45s; 2) warm-run 150 synth requests at 2 qps for 3m; 3) smoke: capture lat_p50, lat_p95, cache_hit_rate, tokens_per_req, error_rate. attach 3 traces.

zane (DE): put a 1-line decision map at top: "cache_hit_rate < 20% -> client prefill; tokens_per_req > 350 -> trim context or request quantized model."

ryan (ENG): tiny runtime snippet to paste: ```
cache_enabled: true
cache_prefix_ttl_ms: 25000
batching: {max_batch: 12, timeout_ms: 10}
streaming: true
```

olga (CS): 15-min script draft: 0:00-1:00 intro; 1:00-5:00 demo cold vs warm; 5:00-9:00 walkthrough runtime + pre-warm; 9:00-12:30 telemetry review; 12:30-15:00 mitigations + owners.

maria (CS Ops): troubleshooting matrix: "p95 > 1s -> reduce batch_timeout or enable streaming; cache_hit_rate < 10% -> inspect prompt variability + enable prefill; error_rate > 0.5% -> collect samples + escalate."

ops-bot: reminder: attach last 8 warm-run traces to tenant ticket before scheduling call.

olga (CS): thanks all, i'll produce the printable one-pager (checkboxes: prefill done, warm-run done, traces attached, telemetry snapshot, mitigation chosen, eng owner). will post PDF in ticket and ping #cs.
